Evelyn / Tessa,

Quick note to kick off the transition for HealthFront (RF-7421). Summary and asks below so CS can take ownership of onboarding and scheduling.

Deal at a glance:
- ARR: $620k/year (first-year commitment)
- Contract signed: 2026-09-28 (e-sign complete)
- Go-live target: 2026-11-15 (customer requested tight ramp)
- Key features purchased: Hosted API + Dedicated Reserved Capacity + Audit Logs export
- Compliance: SOC 2 required; customer will request audit logs and retention settings during onboarding

Attached: HealthFront_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), HealthFront_MAP.xlsx (mutual action plan draft)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7421

Open items I’d like CS to pick up:
1) Primary CSM and PM assignment for implementation
2) Confirm kickoff date (customer prefers week of 10/11)
3) Validate VPC/networking requirements — HealthFront is requesting private VPC peering + restricted egress; engineering may need a network runbook
4) Confirm support/coverage expectations for first 60 days (they asked about elevated SLA during ramp)
5) Coordinate SOC2 evidence delivery and a short security Q&A with their InfoSec (contact below)

Customer contacts:
- Amber Jacobs, Senior IT Ops Manager — amber.jacobs@healthfront.com
- Procurement: procurement@healthfront.com

If you can reply with owners and proposed kickoff window today, I’ll loop the customer in.

Thanks — Ben

Hi all — I’ll take Implementation PM and will draft a 6-week delivery plan for the 11/15 goal. High level timeline below (will convert to a milestone checklist once we lock kickoff):
- Week 0 (kickoff): Confirm roles, runbook delivery, access, and SSO integration plan
- Weeks 1–2: Environment provisioning, VPC peering, and test connectivity
- Weeks 3–4: Data ingestion test, performance tuning with reserved capacity, and KV/cache validation
- Week 5: Dry run and runbook walkthrough with HealthFront engineers
- Week 6: Production cutover and hypercare (first 7 days intensive support)

Open asks for Amber / HealthFront before kickoff:
1) Network CIDRs and desired peering model (AWS account ids if using cross-account)
2) SOC2 questionnaire or a prioritized list of artifacts you need first
3) Any existing firewall or proxy appliances that could impact peering

I’ve attached the kickoff agenda draft (kickoff-agenda-draft.docx) and will add a milestone checklist. Evelyn: I’ll ping infra for a tech lead and request a runbook template.

Tessa
